parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource share.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource share.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type.

Set the value to `ResourceShare`.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description:
The tags.

You can specify up to 20 tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcesharing tag-resources --resource-type ResourceShare --resource-id rs-PqysnzIj0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcesharing TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'rs-PqysnzIj0000' --Tag.1.Key k1 --Tag.1.Value v1 --ResourceType ResourceShare --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
